        How to: Create the List Pane
    
    
         
                Collapse All
                Expand All
            
        View with Navigation Tools
    
    
User Interface Extensibility
 > Metadata Web Pages
 > Insight Pages
 > List Pane
 > How to: Create the List Pane
    
    
    
        The "List Pane" on an insight screen represents the middle section of the screen where grid results and summary tiles are shown. As an example, you can find all of the metadata records for an existing list pane using the following script.


    
        
            
                Shipment insight list pane example

                
                    
                        Copy Code
                    
                
            

            
                
                    
declare @formId numeric(9,0);
declare @paneName nvarchar(25);
set @formId = 2735;
set @paneName = 'ListPane';
select * from SCREEN_PART where PART_NAME = @paneName and SCREEN_ID in (select OBJECT_ID from MAIN_UI_SCREEN where FORM_ID = @formId);
select * from SCREEN_GROUP where SCREEN_PART_ID in (
    select OBJECT_ID from SCREEN_PART where PART_NAME = @paneName and SCREEN_ID in (select OBJECT_ID from MAIN_UI_SCREEN where FORM_ID = @formId));
select * from SCREEN_GROUP_COLUMN where SCREEN_GROUP_ID in (
    select OBJECT_ID from SCREEN_GROUP where SCREEN_PART_ID in (
        select OBJECT_ID from SCREEN_PART where PART_NAME = @paneName and SCREEN_ID in (select OBJECT_ID from MAIN_UI_SCREEN where FORM_ID = @formId)));
select * from SCREEN_CONTROL where SCREEN_GROUP_ID in (
    select OBJECT_ID from SCREEN_GROUP where SCREEN_PART_ID in (
        select OBJECT_ID from SCREEN_PART where PART_NAME = @paneName and SCREEN_ID in (select OBJECT_ID from MAIN_UI_SCREEN where FORM_ID = @formId)));
select * from SCREEN_CONTROL_GRID_COLUMNS where SCREEN_CONTROL_ID in (
    select OBJECT_ID from SCREEN_CONTROL where SCREEN_GROUP_ID in (
        select OBJECT_ID from SCREEN_GROUP where SCREEN_PART_ID in (
            select OBJECT_ID from SCREEN_PART where PART_NAME = @paneName and SCREEN_ID in (select OBJECT_ID from MAIN_UI_SCREEN where FORM_ID = @formId))));
select * from SCREEN_CONTROL_ATTRIBUTES where SCREEN_CONTROL_ID in (
    select OBJECT_ID from SCREEN_CONTROL where SCREEN_GROUP_ID in (
        select OBJECT_ID from SCREEN_GROUP where SCREEN_PART_ID in (
            select OBJECT_ID from SCREEN_PART where PART_NAME = @paneName and SCREEN_ID in (select OBJECT_ID from MAIN_UI_SCREEN where FORM_ID = @formId))));
select * from SCREEN_CONTROL_EVENT where SCREEN_CONTROL_ID in (
    select OBJECT_ID from SCREEN_CONTROL where SCREEN_GROUP_ID in (
        select OBJECT_ID from SCREEN_GROUP where SCREEN_PART_ID in (
            select OBJECT_ID from SCREEN_PART where PART_NAME = @paneName and SCREEN_ID in (select OBJECT_ID from MAIN_UI_SCREEN where FORM_ID = @formId))));
select * from SCREEN_CONTROL_EVENT_PARAMETERS where SCREEN_CONTROL_EVENT_ID in (
    select OBJECT_ID from SCREEN_CONTROL_EVENT where SCREEN_CONTROL_ID in (
        select OBJECT_ID from SCREEN_CONTROL where SCREEN_GROUP_ID in (
            select OBJECT_ID from SCREEN_GROUP where SCREEN_PART_ID in (
                select OBJECT_ID from SCREEN_PART where PART_NAME = @paneName and SCREEN_ID in (select OBJECT_ID from MAIN_UI_SCREEN where FORM_ID = @formId)))));

                
            
        
    




Creating the list pane on an insight screen can be processed as follows.


     Step 1: Create the screen part record for list pane



    Add a SCREEN_PART record as follows. Insight Architect can also be used for this (How to: Use Insight Architect to Customize a Metadata Page).

    
        
            
                Field

                Value
            

            
                SCREEN_ID

                The Screen Id of the current insight screen
            

            
                PART_NAME

                ListPane
            

            
                RESOURCE_KEY

                NULL
            

            
                PART_TYPE

                10 (Div Container)
            

            
                DIV_CSS_CLASS

                col-md-4 col-lg-4 listpanepart
            

            
                DEFAULT_ACTION

                NULL
            
        
    



     Step 2: Add summary tiles



    Please reference the How to: Add a Summary Tile to an Insight List Pane topic for instructions.



     Step 3: Add the grid



    Please reference How to: Add a Grid to an Insight List Pane for more details.

            
            See Also
